Engineering approach

SECURITY CONSIDERED
BEFORE DEPLOYMENT.

The work begins with roles, trust boundaries, state transitions, failure cases, upgrade expectations, and integration requirements. Development includes contract-level testing and clear frontend integration paths. For high-value production protocols, an independent third-party audit is recommended.

Can existing smart contracts be extended?

Yes, when the architecture and permissions allow it. I first review the current contracts, deployment model, and upgrade path before recommending changes.

Can you integrate the contract into a dApp?

Yes. Contract integration can include wallet connection, transactions, read states, event handling, error feedback, and responsive React interfaces.
